description: Architects Registration Board Sri Lanka Institute of Architects (Amendment) Act, No. 14 of 1996- Chartered Architects, Architects, Architactural Licentiates for the Registration of Persons - 2025
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with the registration and regulation of architects under the Sri Lanka Institute of Architects (Amendment) Act, No. 14 of 1996. It involves legal/regulatory matters including statutory registration requirements, recognition of qualifications, maintenance of official registers, and compliance with legislative provisions - all falling under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5).
